question: When is the minor examination for slot K courses?
sources: AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Examination); AY 2026-27_Semester I_Slot System (2nd Year onwards).xlsx (sheet: Slot System)
answer:
The minor examination for slot K courses is on 17 September 2026, Thursday, from 02:00 PM to 04:00 PM.

Institute attendance policy: attendance in every course must not fall below 75%; a student below 75% without a valid reason can be de-registered from the course and then cannot sit its examinations (Source: 7.1_Circular_51Circular-No.-IITJOAACircular2024-2551682-dated-08-July-2024.pdf, page 1).
